desc: Offline Linux nvme-apple port for T6040 based on yuka feature/m4-m5-nvme: ad8908064 (apple,t8132-nvme-ans2, separate mmio_nvmmu, M4 IOQ pointer regs, M4 hw descriptor) + 1b87d7b84 (T6041 DT: three-region reg nvme=reg[9] 0x4dcc0000/0x10000, ans mailbox 0x09600000/0x4000, nvmmu=reg[3] 0x0dcc0000/0x60000; reg-names nvme/ans/nvmmu; apple,sart, 4 mailbox irqs, ANS/APCIE power-domains, ANS reset). NOT a blind copy: her M4/M5 commits are marked untested and 9a6a6bd18 disables Set Features/Number-of-Queues because it CRASHES ANS on 26.x. Preserve the reg[3] caveat (not a clean NVMMU-only window: +0x1300 readable, +0x1210 faulted 07-25). Open anomaly to carry: delete sq/cq returns status 2 = Invalid Field (NOT Invalid Opcode) - lead is M4 queue-state/teardown-order around the IOQ pointer regs. Adapt DT numbers from OUR captured ADT, not t6041 copy-paste. NO live writes or boots until separately reviewed. PROGRESS 2026-07-30: yuka ad890806+9a6a6bd1+3b6b20a8 cherry-picked to wallace/t6040-bringup; t6040 DT node written from OUR ADT (irqs match t6041; sart 0xc000; old single-base node REPLACED); NVME_APPLE=y (APPLE_SART=m pin fixed); v3 object 65f6fbe3 packed+allowlisted. First boot = first live nvme-apple probe on T6040; dual-mode+rollback is the net. FIRST BOOT RESULT (v4, 2026-07-30): driver+DT proven through identify + 3-namespace enumeration, then ANS FIRMWARE crashed -- wake-path-into-live-iBoot-ANS root cause (our loader lacks m1n1 nvme_shutdown). Kernel fix patches/t6040-nvme-apple-force-clean-ans-boot.patch forces the clean boot path; v5 object 16a4c594. Upstream-relevant robustness patch + the m1n1 nvme_ensure_shutdown gap both drafted for CJ.
author: claude
